portable_release_shape: optional replaceable local model attachment when local inference is selected
mission: Finish and empirically prove one persistent portable multi-use mini entity: executable contains only the generic processing pipeline; Zero blog is fully editable SQLite application configuration; inference can be remote API, local server, or direct local model.

hard_split.binary: evidence -> generic preprocessor -> canonical envelope -> configured inference backend -> generic gates -> exactly-once/CAS -> atomic SQLite persistence
hard_split.database: profile/personality/system prompt/application blob/provider and local-inference settings plus default zero_blog preset
hard_split.regression: never hard-code replaceable Zero/blog/personality semantics into the executable

truth_law: UNKNOWN != ZERO != ERROR != MEASURED; model narrative is never canonical state authority

inference_law.local_server: localhost compatible text generation with optional authentication
inference_law.local_model: direct replaceable local model attachment; first reference target GGUF via llama.cpp-compatible runtime
inference_law.identity: switching inference backend or model must not reset MiniUnifiedDB state/history

go: Maximal swarm cycle on this one neutral pipeline + configurable DB only: refresh, fan-out, hypotheses, counterhypotheses, implement, sandbox-test, falsify, fuse/hypofuse, fix, retest, persist. Direct local-model support remains a required frontier until sandbox-proven.
swarm_product_rule: swarm is research/build orchestration only; product runtime is exactly one entity
legacy_scope: All previous ClayVerse/EntityOS/Frank/UCM/GWT/ClayCode work is donor evidence only unless it advances this mini entity.
